title: Pod service-account token + node-escape primitive
impact: A usable pod service-account token plus a pod-create / hostPath / privileged primitive is a path from pod to node (host) root.
remediation: Scope the service account (RBAC); block hostPath/privileged pods via admission policy; restrict docker.sock.
description: EXAMPLE COMMUNITY RULE. A pod SA token co-occurs with a node-escape primitive; chain to node root. Copy this file to start your own pack.
